metadata.analysis_type: failure patterns and operational risk assessment

overall_assessment.summary: Both services achieved perfect deployment records with zero failures during the analysis period
overall_assessment.key_observation: With zero failures, this analysis focuses on operational patterns, deployment rhythms, and potential risk indicators rather than traditional failure modes

shared_success_patterns.description: Both services achieved 100% deployment success with zero failures, rollbacks, or incidents

shared_stability_patterns.description: Both services maintained 100% uptime with zero-downtime deployments

shared_deployment_patterns.description: Both services show relatively low deployment frequency, suggesting stable mature services or conservative release practices
implications: Low deployment risk due to infrequent changes
Potential for feature stagnation if too conservative
Easy to maintain high success rates with low deployment volume
shared_deployment_patterns.trend: Stable but may indicate over-conservative release practices

steady_rhythm_pattern.description: pbx-web deployments spread evenly over 16 days (every ~3 days) with consistent weekly activity
benefits: No deployment clustering or burst pressure
risks: Minimal - steady rhythm reduces deployment stress

log_error_pattern.description: pbx-web has 6 log errors despite 100% deployment success - these are non-fatal errors that don't block deployments
potential_causes: Expected error handling for edge cases
log_error_pattern.recommendation: Investigate log error patterns to ensure they're truly benign
log_error_pattern.trend: Requires investigation to confirm non-critical nature

active_maintenance_pattern.description: pbx-web has consistent recent deployment activity (last deployment 9 days ago) indicating active maintenance
benefits: Lower risk of bit rot or dependency staleness

burst_deployment_pattern.pattern: Burst deployment with extended idle periods
burst_deployment_pattern.description: whisper-stt had 4 deployments in 5 days (burst pattern) followed by 25+ days of complete inactivity
risks: Potential for bit rot or dependency staleness
Unclear if service is neglected or frozen in stable state
Large batched deployments may carry more risk per deployment
burst_deployment_pattern.trend: Concerning - extended idle period may indicate neglect or frozen service

clean_logs_pattern.description: whisper-stt has perfectly clean logs with zero errors - suggests mature error handling or low verbosity
potential_explanations: Mature error handling prevents logged errors
Lower deployment volume reduces error exposure
Service may be less feature-rich (fewer edge cases)
clean_logs_pattern.trend: Positive - indicates clean operation or conservative logging

low_frequency_pattern.description: whisper-stt only deployed on 2 days out of 30-day analysis period - extremely low activity
low_frequency_pattern.deployment_density: 4 deployments in 5 days, then 16+ days idle
risks: Service may be neglected or abandoned
Potential security vulnerabilities from lack of updates
Unclear if this is intentional stability or problematic neglect
low_frequency_pattern.trend: Concerning - extended idle period needs investigation
low_frequency_pattern.recommendation: Investigate whether whisper-stt is intentionally stable or unintentionally neglected

low_risk_indicators.mitigation: Continue current monitoring and response practices

medium_risk_indicators.severity: unclear - could be intentional stability or neglect
medium_risk_indicators.mitigation: Investigate service status, determine if staleness is intentional
medium_risk_indicators.action: Check if whisper-stt is in maintenance freeze or intentionally stable

medium_risk_indicators.severity: low - non-blocking but may indicate edge cases
medium_risk_indicators.mitigation: Investigate log error patterns to confirm benign nature
medium_risk_indicators.action: Review log error types and frequencies

recommendations.reason: 25+ days without deployment may indicate neglect or frozen service
recommendations.suggested_investigation: Check service roadmap, maintenance status, and dependency health

recommendations.reason: 6 non-fatal errors may indicate edge cases or transient issues
recommendations.suggested_investigation: Categorize log error types and determine if they're truly benign

recommendations.action: Document burst vs steady deployment strategies
recommendations.reason: Both patterns work (100% success) - document as valid deployment strategies
recommendations.suggested_action: Capture team rationale for each service's deployment rhythm

week_1_2026-07-07.observation: whisper-stt burst window, pbx-web steady start

week_4_2026-07-28.observation: whisper-stt remains idle, pbx-web continues steady rhythm

deployment_frequency_trend.whisper-stt: burst in first week, then complete idle period

staleness_trend.whisper-stt: increasing staleness trend (16+ days and counting)

medium_severity.impact: potential neglect or bit rot risk

deployment_frequency_vs_success.observation: No correlation - both services achieved 100% success despite different deployment frequencies and patterns
deployment_frequency_vs_success.conclusion: Success rate is driven by deployment quality and testing, not frequency or rhythm

deployment_pattern_vs_stability.observation: Both patterns (steady vs burst) achieve 100% uptime and zero-downtime deployments
deployment_pattern_vs_stability.conclusion: Both steady and burst deployment patterns can produce stable outcomes when properly executed

staleness_vs_risk.observation: whisper-stt's 25+ day idle period creates uncertainty about service status
staleness_vs_risk.conclusion: Extended deployment gaps may indicate either intentional stability or problematic neglect - requires investigation

log_errors_vs_success.observation: pbx-web has 6 log errors but 100% success; whisper-stt has 0 log errors and 100% success
log_errors_vs_success.conclusion: Log error count does not correlate with deployment success in this dataset

key_findings: Both services achieved perfect deployment records with zero failures during the 30-day analysis period
No common failure patterns exist - both services operated flawlessly
pbx-web exhibits a steady, consistent deployment rhythm (every ~3 days) indicating active maintenance
whisper-stt exhibits a burst deployment pattern (4 deployments in 5 days) followed by 25+ days of inactivity
The primary operational difference is deployment rhythm: steady (pbx-web) vs burst+idle (whisper-stt)
whisper-stt's extended idle period (25+ days) is the main risk indicator requiring investigation
pbx-web's 6 non-fatal log errors warrant review but do not impact deployment success
Low deployment volume across both services suggests conservative release practices or stable mature services
operational_insights: Both deployment patterns (steady and burst) can produce perfect outcomes when properly executed
Deployment success is driven by quality and process, not frequency or rhythm
Extended deployment gaps create uncertainty about service status and require investigation
Non-fatal log errors may exist even with perfect deployment success rates

risk_summary.recommendation: Investigate whisper-stt maintenance status and pbx-web log error patterns
